whiteLabel.title: White-label clients
whiteLabel.subtitle: Register organisations and manage their offers, access and history.
whiteLabel.createHint: The client starts as a draft. Configure its contract before activation. No account or email is created automatically.
whiteLabel.name: Organisation name
whiteLabel.moduleHint: Only selected modules will be available to the client. User permissions are managed separately.
whiteLabel.detailHint: Client configuration. Viewing its programmes requires explicit supervision.
whiteLabel.closedHint: This client record is closed and remains available for reference. Its history is retained.
whiteLabel.statusConfirmation: Confirm the status change? Suspension or closure denies access to the client portal. Closure cannot be reversed on this screen.
whiteLabel.contractHint: Activation requires a signed contract that is active today. Contract dates apply to the selected modules. When suspending or ending the contract, also adjust the client status.
whiteLabel.newContractPrompt: What is the new offer reference? The previous contract will be retained.
whiteLabel.brandingHint: The name, logo and colour apply to this client workspace. Use a readable colour and an HTTPS or local logo URL.
whiteLabel.inviteHint: Create or link an external account and choose its permissions in this organisation. No internal Future Studio role is granted. No email is sent automatically.
whiteLabel.inviteConfirmation: Create or link this account and grant the selected permissions? You will receive a personal link. Existing passwords will remain unchanged.
whiteLabel.inviteReady: Access is configured. Share this link with the person.
whiteLabel.invitePrivate: A password-setup link is personal, single-use and valid for 48 hours. For an activated account, the link opens the normal sign-in page.
whiteLabel.recentUsers: The 100 most recent memberships are shown.
whiteLabel.noUsers: No users linked to this client.
whiteLabel.accessConfirmation: Confirm access changes? An ended membership cannot be reactivated; a new invitation will be needed.
whiteLabel.supervisionHint: Authorise a Future Studio user to view this client’s programmes, with a reason and an expiry (up to 7 days). This authorisation is read-only.
whiteLabel.supervisionConfirmation: Grant this temporary viewing authorisation? Consultations will be recorded.
whiteLabel.programReadHint: The button below uses your own supervision rights. Being a super administrator alone does not grant access to client programmes. The first 20 programmes are shown.
whiteLabel.mandateRequired: Viewing unavailable: check your personal authorisation, its expiry, the client status and its Programmes module.
whiteLabel.historyHint: The 100 latest events for this client are shown. Management actions and supervised consultations are recorded.

errors.conflict: This record has changed. Refresh it before trying again. Your changes were not saved.
errors.closed: This client record is closed and cannot be edited here.
errors.contractRequired: A signed contract active today is required to activate this client.
errors.contractEnded: This contract has ended. Create a new contract instead of editing its history.
errors.endContract: End the active contract before creating a new one.
errors.roleModule: One of the selected permissions requires a module not included in the offer.
errors.accountConflict: This account needs review: it may be duplicated, internal, deleted or suspended. No existing account was changed.
errors.memberSuspended: This membership is suspended. Explicitly update its access before inviting again.
errors.memberEnded: This membership has ended or cannot be found. A new invitation is required.
errors.duplicate: This identifier or record already exists. Check the record and refresh it.
errors.schemaMissing: The database update required for client administration is not installed in this environment yet.
